description.value: Sunset Farm is a 45-year-old working sheep farm run by Sandy Robley on Salt Spring Island's Sunset Drive, spanning over 300 acres of owned and leased Gulf Islands pasture. The farm shop offers farm-fresh eggs, island lamb, and chicken alongside a wide selection of wool goods including yarns, blankets, sheepskins, and handmade crafts. The farm has a notable history of supplying lamb for Queen Elizabeth's visit to Victoria in the 1980s.

address.value: 1325 Sunset Drive, Salt Spring Island, V8K1E2
